nodes.summary: Rigorous QSSA (Tikhonov 1952; Heineken–Tsuchiya–Aris 1967). On the slow time scale `τ = e₀ t`, the substrate of the full Michaelis–Menten system with `s(0) = s₀`, `c(0) = 0`, `e(0) = e₀` stays within `C e₀` of the solution `S̄` of the reduced equation `dS̄/dτ = -k₂ S̄ / (K_M + S̄)`, `S̄(0) = s₀`, uniformly on `[0, T]`.
nodes.title: Rigorous QSSA

nodes.summary: With total enzyme `e₀` (so `e = e₀ - c`), `k₁ > 0` and `K_M + s ≠ 0`, the complex is stationary iff `c = e₀ s / (K_M + s)`.
nodes.title: Quasi-steady-state manifold

nodes.summary: The mass-action rate of the complex, `c' = k₁ e s - (kb + k₂) c`.
nodes.title: Mass-action rate of the enzyme–substrate complex

nodes.summary: The fast transient of the complex with the substrate frozen at `s̄`: `c(t) = c* + (c₀ - c*) e^{-k₁ (s̄ + K_M) t}`, where `c* = e₀ s̄ / (K_M + s̄)`.
nodes.title: Fast transient of the complex with frozen substrate

nodes.summary: The fast transient solves the boundary-layer equation `c' = k₁ (e₀ - c) s̄ - (kb + k₂) c` for `k₁ > 0` and `K_M + s̄ ≠ 0`.
nodes.title: Fast transient solves the boundary-layer equation

nodes.summary: A solution of the Michaelis–Menten mass-action system on `[0, ∞)`: `s' = -k₁ e s + kb c`, `c' = k₁ e s - (kb + k₂) c`, `e' = -c'`, `p' = k₂ c`.
nodes.title: Solution of the Michaelis–Menten mass-action system

nodes.summary: The Michaelis constant `K_M = (kb + k₂)/k₁` (Briggs–Haldane). Meaningful for `k₁ > 0`.
nodes.title: Michaelis constant

nodes.summary: The rate law is below its maximum: `v(s) < V_max` for `s ≥ 0`, `V_max, K_M > 0`.
nodes.title: Michaelis–Menten rate stays below its maximum

nodes.summary: The Michaelis constant is the half-saturation substrate level: `v(K_M) = V_max / 2`.
nodes.title: Michaelis constant is the half-saturation substrate level

nodes.summary: The rate law is strictly increasing on `s ≥ 0` for `V_max, K_M > 0`.
nodes.title: Michaelis–Menten rate is strictly increasing

nodes.summary: The Michaelis–Menten rate law `v(s) = V_max s / (K_M + s)`.
nodes.title: Michaelis–Menten rate law

nodes.summary: On the quasi-steady-state manifold the product forms at rate `k₂ c = V_max s / (K_M + s)`, `V_max = k₂ e₀`.
nodes.title: Briggs–Haldane rate law

nodes.summary: The quasi-steady-state value of the complex, `c = e₀ s / (K_M + s)`.
nodes.title: Quasi-steady-state value of the complex

nodes.summary: On the quasi-steady-state manifold the substrate is consumed at the Michaelis–Menten rate: `s' = -V_max s / (K_M + s)`.
nodes.title: Substrate consumption at the Michaelis–Menten rate under QSSA

nodes.summary: The mass-action rate of the substrate, `s' = -k₁ e s + kb c`.
nodes.title: Mass-action rate of the substrate

nodes.summary: The fast transient converges to the quasi-steady-state value for `k₁ > 0` and `s̄ + K_M > 0`.
nodes.title: Fast transient converges to the quasi-steady state

conditional.label: conditionally proved

fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
